newsitem.title: FRANCE: Cie des Signaux sees Matra winning Thomson-CSF.
newsitem.headline: Cie des Signaux sees Matra winning Thomson-CSF.

text.p: The chairman of French electronics company Compagnie des Signaux believes Lagardere Groupe's Matra has the industrial and financial credentials to buy Thomson-CSF in the state's privatisation, newspaper Le Figaro reported on Tuesday.
"The choice of Matra has the double advantage of being legitimate on an industrial basis and meeting the restructuring criteria set by the state," Yazid Sabeg said in an interview.
Matra, which is profitable, is the biggest in its class of medium-sized companies, has strong interests in missiles and satellites and would be complementary to Thomson-CSF, he said.
Matra is the only candidate which has the financial means to buy Thomson-CSF without excessive debt and without needing an international alliance," he said.

Cie des Signaux, which makes an annual one billion francs in defence sales, would not sell any of its military activities to Thomson-CSF, but would be ready to build groupings with Thomson and its owners to make a significant presence on the world market, he said.
The government is expected to give details soon of the Thomson privatisation, which could be either a public share offer or a private placement.
Matra Defense Espace and Alcatel Alsthom were the two declared bidders for Thomson-CSF.
